'''D. L. Travos''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served on board the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Travos was very proud to have been assigned to the Death Star and was impressed by the power of the battle station.
